gaps.text: In-line measurement of turbidity / light scattering with turbidity or backscatter sensor
In-line measurement of stream temperature with temperature sensor

Combining several spectroscopy methods (data fusion) (Fusion level: one calibrated model per method first, then joined spectra with block scaling so that neither method dominates the model. The NIR and Raman probes must look at the same small area of the stream, and the two acquisition rates must be aligned to a common time step, with each block kept under its own calibration and diagnostics. The fused model must beat the best single NIR method on held-out runs, otherwise the second instrument is dropped.)

Protein performance figures for whey: the sources describe milk fat and protein and dairy geometry, but give no protein accuracy, detection limit or response time for whey or for a stream that changes from clear to turbid.

items.finding: The source says block scaling is often recommended for data fusion but can sometimes worsen results compared with other pre-processing methods.
items.how_it_applies: For O3, this suggests testing block scaling against alternative pre-processing and checking whether the fused model beats the best single NIR method on held-out runs.
items.limits_and_transfer_risks: The evidence comes from dairy-industry spectroscopy data fusion, not from a NIR/Raman stream with aligned acquisition rates or a shared small measurement area, so the scaling effect may differ.

citation.quote: While block scaling is often recommended for data fusion, sometimes it can have a worse effect on results than other pre-processing methods (17).
citation.label: E03 ¶16

items.finding: The source says SO-PLS is independent of block scaling and therefore not affected by variance differences between data blocks.
items.how_it_applies: For O3, SO-PLS could be considered as a fusion approach that may avoid block-scaling sensitivity, but it still needs comparison against the best single NIR method on held-out runs.
items.limits_and_transfer_risks: The source is dairy data fusion and does not establish performance for NIR and Raman probes on the same stream area or with aligned time steps.

citation.quote: SO-PLS is not affected by scaling of each block as it is independent of the scaling, therefore is not affected by variance differences between data blocks (22).
citation.label: E03 ¶19
